findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in HTTP responses
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data from HTTP responses can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-http
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Look for pickle/yaml/marshal deserialization calls
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load", "full_load", "load_all"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("load").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted HTTP response data could lead to code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.
Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure TLS/SSL configuration
 * @description Potentially insecure SSL/TLS configuration in HTTP client
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Disabling SSL verification
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember(["_create_unverified_context", "create_default_context"]).getACall() or
    // Insecure SSL/TLS versions or ciphers
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember(["SSLContext", "wrap_socket"]).getACall() or
    // Setting verify=False in HTTP clients
    call = API::moduleImport("httpx").getMember("Client").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure SSL/TLS configuration that could disable certificate verification."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure TLS/SSL configuration in HTTP client library
